title: The Best Country in the World for Drivers
summary: Not Just Bikes argues that the Netherlands, famed for cycling, is also the best country for drivers. It explains how prioritizing walking, cycling and transit makes driving faster and more pleasant.
why: Recommended as the argument that better alternatives to driving also improve things for drivers, and as an introduction to Dutch urban planning.

quote.text: One of the many excellent videos on the Not Just Bikes YouTube channel [1] shows how the Netherlands has done it.
